questions.questionText:
Is the positive integer n an even number?

I. n is divisible by 8.
II. n lies between 10 and 30.

Which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question?

options.text: Statement I alone is sufficient, but Statement II alone is not sufficient.
Statement II alone is sufficient, but Statement I alone is not sufficient.
Both statements together are sufficient, but neither statement alone is sufficient.
Even both statements together are not sufficient.

questions.explanationText: Statement I alone: every multiple of 8 is also a multiple of 2, so n is definitely even; a definite YES is obtained. Statement II alone: the range 10 to 30 contains both even and odd integers, so no definite answer is possible. Therefore, Statement I alone is sufficient, but Statement II alone is not sufficient.
